source.title: TideLab existing RSI14 rule coverage fixture

claim.attributed_summary: Authored coverage fixture for the already implemented RSI14 long/cash contract; no new strategy or performance claim.

interpretation.product_scope: One synthetic spot-like instrument and cash; no market candidate is selected.
interpretation.timeframe: One closed synthetic hourly bar per decision, with a next-hour hypothetical fill.
required_data: TideLab-authored complete synthetic hourly open and close bars.
required_capabilities: Synthetic long/cash target and deterministic next-open fill contract.
interpretation.entry: Flat: pinned-LEAN Wilder RSI14 strictly below 30.
interpretation.exit: Held: pinned-LEAN Wilder RSI14 strictly above 70.
interpretation.sizing: 25% of signal-time cash; executable quantity follows the common manifest cost model.
interpretation.timing: Fifteen preceding bars under the existing contract; next scored open, no terminal liquidation.
